summary: IQM Quantum Computers Oyj filed a Form 6-K with the SEC on July 6, 2026, reporting routine transactions by persons discharging managerial responsibilities (PDMRs) via stock exchange releases. The filings include disposals of shares by Juha Hassel at prices ranging from €16.30 to €18.21 per share and a subscription by an entity closely associated with board member Alexander Doll at $10 per share. No board recommendation, advisor, or deal structure is mentioned. This is a routine disclosure of insider transactions, not a special situation. Watch for no further action; this is regulatory compliance.
